content.comment_body: Hello, I am currently facing a network communication issue between two connected [product_name] modules in the following configuration: one module set as master, the other as slave, along with a [product_name] operator device. The connection between the master and slave uses about 150-250 meters of Cat5e ethernet cable, which appears to sometimes disrupt communication, likely due to the distance. I am considering adding an ethernet switch to improve the signal. I also discovered that [company_name] offers the [product_name] network module. Would using this module enhance signal reliability between the two modules? If so, is one module sufficient, or would I need two? Any other recommendations for achieving a stable connection would be appreciated. Thank you for any assistance.
Cat5e cable is best limited to 100 meters. Consider installing a network switch around the 80-90 meter point to act as a repeater.

I've encountered setups with cable runs up to 150 meters, assuming high-quality cable and low electrical noise. However, in areas with heavy electrical interference, even 60 meters can be problematic despite good cable and grounding. For distances of 150-250 meters without the possibility of placing a hub midway, consider twisted pair adapters to CAT; these slow down to 10Mbit, but that's typically sufficient for this type of application.

As mentioned, placing a switch in the latter half of the network is advisable. In my experience, projects with more than 100-150 meters between [product_name] modules usually work well if you use shielded FTP cable for runs longer than 60-70 meters. Make sure to connect the shield to ground on only one end of the cable, typically at the power source.

analysis.insight_summary: The user is experiencing unreliable network communication between two [product_name] modules over a 150-250 meter Cat5e ethernet connection. The main challenge is maintaining stable connectivity over long distances, with uncertainty regarding optimal hardware solutions and best practices for industrial network reliability.
analysis.user_expectations: The user seeks consistent and dependable network communication between two [product_name] modules, regardless of cable length, and is looking for clear recommendations on suitable [company_name] hardware solutions to improve network stability.
